faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services and processes.
faq.q1: How do I start my own Live TV channel?
faq.a1: With Ai ivb7 you can set up your own branded Live TV channel in days, not months — we handle the servers, encoding and delivery so you can focus on content.
faq.q2: Can I broadcast 24×7 without keeping my computer on?
faq.a2: Yes. Your programming runs on our broadcast servers, not your laptop — schedule once and it keeps streaming 24×7 even when your computer is off.
faq.q3: Do I need high-speed internet to broadcast?
faq.a3: No. Our servers handle the heavy lifting, so even a modest internet connection at your location is enough to push your feed live.
faq.q4: Can AI really automate my TV channel?
faq.a4: Yes — AI can schedule, program and run your channel automatically: playlists, ad insertion, and fully automated Live TV without manual intervention.
faq.q5: Can I broadcast to multiple platforms at the same time?
faq.a5: Yes. One upload broadcasts simultaneously to Facebook, YouTube, OTT platforms, IPTV, websites and local cable — no repeated uploads needed.
faq.q6: Can I combine social media, OTT and local cable TV?
faq.a6: Yes — you're not limited to one distribution channel. Social media, OTT apps and local cable TV can all carry your channel from the same feed.
faq.q7: Do I own the broadcasting servers?
faq.a7: Yes. You get your own dedicated broadcasting servers with full control — it's your infrastructure and your rules, not a shared or rented slot.
faq.q8: Can I build my own television network?
faq.a8: Absolutely. With your own servers, control panel and branding, you can build a full multi-channel television network under your own name.
faq.q9: How much cheaper is this than satellite TV?
faq.a9: A fraction of the cost — no transponder leasing or satellite uplink infrastructure required, just our AI-powered broadcast servers.
faq.a10: Yes. Once you're live, your channel reaches viewers on every major platform and screen — anywhere in the world with an internet connection.
